featuredTitle: Ready to take off. And to end up on the grill.
footer: From Abruzzo, with a love for the grill.
footerAbout: Arrosticini from Abruzzo, shipped refrigerated worldwide.
storyIntro: An Abruzzo tradition, one skewer at a time.
storyBody: Arrosticini are small skewers of sheep meat, cooked over a narrow charcoal grill called a fornacella and shared around a table. Arrosticini 24ore starts from this tradition to imagine a shop that brings it to the world.
deliveryIntro: Tradition travels. Flavour reaches its destination.
deliveryBody: This shop is a demo project: purchases and payments are for testing and do not involve real deliveries. Refrigerated shipping is part of the experience represented by the site.
